description: Read one to ten Goals by goalIds, returned in the same order under goals (a read never puts you on them). history applies to every requested Goal. A refused read fails the call with its original refusal; no partial result is presented as complete. Each Goal includes its ten most recent other contributors (names, latest entry headlines and times), outcome, state, revision, progress, blockers, the conversation on it (each question with its options and what was decided), `next`, the one step to take, and `more`, where to read further. A question in that conversation reads `open` (nothing yet), `answered` (a choice was made, and `answer` carries it), `replied` (they said something and the read settled the question on their words — NO option of yours was chosen, and the words are the reply line beside it, so read that before you act), or `closed`. The conversation carries everything the person said, every open question and your newest entry; your older entries are left out and counted — history: true reads every entry in full. Every Goal of your person is readable, whichever of their agents owns it; another account's Goals are not disclosed.

goalIds.description: The Goals to read, in order; one to ten IDs.
